name: Toudou Chieri
source:
Star Sign: Scorpio

The protagonist's homeroom teacher, his subject is ceramics.
He has a listless and pessimistic personality, he's always thinking about the long term.
Also the advisor to the Spring Festival committee, he knows [url=/c53456]Rintarou[/url], [url=/c53457]Rui[/url], [url=/c53458]Monet[/url], and [url=/c53459]Kanato[/url] quite well.
It seems he knows something about the protagonist's mother as well?
